title: 第32章 邀请第33章 火花
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
和夏普太太聊的很开心，毕竟夏普太太有心结交莫甘娜，而莫甘娜也有意接触这位在廷根有好几座纺织工厂的夏普太太，后续的计划，还需要她的帮忙呢。
不过两人并没有聊很久，奥莱尔就来寻找莫甘娜了，宴会的时间并不是很长，他们还有其他结识的目标。
收下了来自夏普太太的下午茶邀请，莫甘娜就跟着奥莱尔离开了。
“多洛万·夏普，他可不是什么简单的人，”奥莱尔小声提醒道，“短短的三年时间，他将他的财富翻了几倍，他的妻子，是一直陪他一起过来的，是个极其好心的人。”
“我知道了，父亲，我并没有和夏普家合作的打算，我们只是刚好遇上而已。”
莫甘娜理解奥莱尔话语里的含义，多洛万能在三年的时间将自己的财富不断翻倍，在证明他是有能力的同时，也说明了一件事，他是为典型的追逐利益的商人，而夏普太太，能陪着夏普先生打拼到现在这个地位，还得了一个好心的评价，只能说，大家都是极其擅长隐藏自己的人。
奥莱尔并不是想要控制莫甘娜的人际交往，只是，“你需要小心，这样的人最是容易背后做小手段，如果将来你要和他们合作，要做好准备。”
莫甘娜虚心的接受了奥莱尔的建议，跟随在奥莱尔身边，认识了一个又个的人。
“那是雪伦夫人，她还是一如既往的具有魅力……”
忠实的听众莫甘娜连忙打量说话者示意的方向，雪伦夫人，按理来说，也算是父亲击杀的目标吧？
雪伦夫人正端着一杯香槟，与身旁的绅士谈笑风生。
莫甘娜只轻轻一瞥，便收回目光，继续听着父亲和其他人的交谈。
很多人都从各处听说了莫甘娜被奥莱尔定下为继承人的事情，虽然心里感到诧异，觉得维斯珀子爵是糊涂了，可是面上仍旧是保持着得体的微笑，以继承者的态度对待莫甘娜。
时间渐渐推移，宴会接近尾声，宾客们陆续告辞，奥莱尔也带这莫甘娜离开了。
“真可惜，我今天并没有和雪伦夫人交流过，她是那样的美丽，让所有人都喜欢。”马车上，莫甘娜看似不经意的提起了雪伦夫人。
莫甘娜还是选择除掉雪伦夫人，她在廷根还有布置，虽然不知道能不能起作用，所以为了更加保险，雪伦夫人还是早点去死吧。
奥莱尔皱起眉头，第一次觉得孩子真的很难带，“莫甘娜，你不是普通人，你不觉得能让你第一次见面就喜欢上的人很特殊吗？”
奥莱尔就差明示雪伦夫人有问题了，莫甘娜自然不能装傻了，当下大惊，握住奥莱尔的手，声音微颤询问，“那她得是什么样的强者，父亲……”
“不用害怕，我会处理好的。”
得到承诺的莫甘娜恢复镇定，她当然不会害怕，莫甘娜不说能击杀雪伦夫人，在她面皮下逃跑也是没有问题，她有什么可怕的。

第二天一早，莫甘娜就看到报纸上登载着雪伦夫人昨夜归家途中遭遇劫匪，不幸殒命的消息。
啊~父亲出手真是迅速呀！
既然雪伦夫人已经死了，之后应该就不会有那么多事情了，莫甘娜轻轻合上报纸，准备起今天下午的下午茶服装。
下午的阳光很好，三两夫人、小姐聚集在小亭，聊着家中的小事。
content_en:
I had a great time chatting with Mrs. Sharp. After all, Mrs. Sharp is interested in making friends with Morgana, and Morgana is also interested in getting in touch with Mrs. Sharp, who owns several textile factories in Tingen. Her help will be needed for subsequent plans.
However, the two did not chat for a long time before Aurel came to look for Morgana. The banquet was not very long and they had other targets to get acquainted with.
After accepting the afternoon tea invitation from Mrs. Sharp, Morgana left with Orel.
"Dorovan Sharp, he is not a simple person," Olaier reminded in a low voice. "In just three years, he has doubled his wealth several times. His wife has been here with him all the time. She is an extremely kind person."
"I understand, father, I have no intention of cooperating with the Sharp family. We just happened to meet each other."
Morgana understood the meaning of Orel's words. Dorovan's ability to continuously double his wealth in three years not only proved that he was capable, but also showed one thing. He was a typical businessman who pursued profits. And Mrs. Sharp was able to accompany Mr. Sharp to his current position and received a kind evaluation. It can only be said that everyone is extremely good at hiding themselves.
Aurel did not want to control Morgana's interpersonal interactions, but said, "You need to be careful. People like this are most likely to do tricks behind the scenes. If you want to cooperate with them in the future, be prepared."
Morgana humbly accepted Aurel's suggestion, followed Aurel, and got to know one person after another.
"That's Mrs. Sharon, she is as charming as ever..."
The loyal listener Morgana quickly looked in the direction indicated by the speaker. Mrs. Sharon, logically speaking, could be considered the target of her father's killing, right?
Mrs. Sharon was holding a glass of champagne and chatting and laughing with the gentleman next to her.
Morgana only glanced briefly, then withdrew her gaze and continued to listen to the conversation between her father and others.
Many people had heard from various places that Morgana was appointed as the heir by Orel. Although they were surprised and felt that Viscount Vesper was confused, they still maintained a decent smile on their faces and treated Morgana with the attitude of an heir.
Time gradually passed, and the banquet came to an end. The guests left one after another, and Aurel also took Morgana away.
"It's a pity that I didn't communicate with Mrs. Sharon today. She is so beautiful that everyone likes her." On the carriage, Morgana mentioned Mrs. Sharon seemingly casually.
Morgana still chose to get rid of Mrs. Sharon. She had plans in Tingen. Although she didn't know if it would work, so to be more safe, Mrs. Sharon should die early.
Orel frowned. For the first time, he felt that it was really difficult to raise a child. "Morgana, you are not an ordinary person. Don't you think that the person who makes you fall in love with her the first time you meet her is special?"
Orel just wanted to make it clear that there was something wrong with Mrs. Sharon. Naturally, Morgana couldn't pretend to be stupid. She was shocked. She held Orel's hand and asked in a slightly trembling voice, "Then what kind of strong person must she be, father..."
"Don't be afraid, I will take care of it."
Morgana regained her composure after receiving the promise. Of course she would not be afraid. Not to mention that Morgana could kill Mrs. Sharon, and there was no problem in escaping in her presence. What was there to be afraid of?
Early the next morning, Morgana saw the news in the newspaper that Mrs. Sharon encountered a robber on her way home last night and died unfortunately.
Ah~ My father took action so quickly!
Now that Mrs. Sharon is dead, there shouldn't be so many things happening in the future. Morgana gently closed the newspaper and prepared her outfit for this afternoon's tea.
The afternoon sun was very bright, and three ladies and young ladies gathered in the pavilion, chatting about trivial matters at home.
